blocks.text: The Filipinos’ bayanihan spirit propelled Sasha Lacuna at the online poll for the “Miss Social Media” award at the ongoing The Miss Globe pageant in Thailand, pushing the Binibining Pilipinas titleholder at the top at the end of the first round of voting. The Tarlaqueña university student received the highest number of votes during the first round of voting from Oct 30 to Nov. 2, and will be moving on to Round 2 with the rest of the Top 10 delegates who amassed the most votes. This was announced on The Miss Globe pageant’s social media pages on Monday, Nov. 2. […]... Keep on reading: Sasha Lacuna tops The Miss Globe 2026 'Miss Social Media' Round 1 poll
